articles.title: PREVIEW: Panthers ready to face ‘great transition game’ in Anaheim
‘A great boost’: Marchand set to make season debut vs. Ducks
Gudas welcomed back with ovation during return to Anaheim

out.detail: Injured: lower body (placed on LTIR, expected to miss 6-8 weeks)
Injured: lower body (but returning per article; however, projected lineups list him as injured, so included as out with note)

away.summary: The Panthers are without captain Aleksander Barkov (lower body, LTIR, 6-8 weeks out) and will also miss Jonah Gadjovich (neck) and Brad Marchand (lower body, though he is returning for this game per a separate article). Aaron Ekblad, Sam Lafferty, and Alexander Petrovic are scratched. The team expects to dress the same lineup used in their 3-2 OT loss at Anaheim, with Lars Eller centering Barkov’s usual line and Gustav Forsling a game-time decision.

out.detail: Injured: leg surgery (resumed skating, expected back in early November)

home.summary: The Kings are coming off a 5-4 OT loss to the Sharks, earning their first point of the season. Darcy Kuemper is projected to start in net, the only change from their last game. Kevin Fiala remains out after leg surgery but has resumed skating and could return in early November. Andre Lee and Samuel Helenius are scratched.
